drinkware-201.description:
Milton Thermosteel Insulated Coffee Mug is a leak-proof and durable flask made of stainless steel. The mug retains the temperature of beverages, making it ideal for carrying coffee, soup, tea, and more. It comes with a 1-year warranty and is built to withstand the demands of everyday use. The insulated technology keeps beverages hot or cold for hours, making it perfect for any trip or on-the-go use. The flask is rust-proof, user-friendly, and highly functional, making it an appropriate choice for storing beverages.

Features:

Copper coating improves insulation
Vacuum insulation maintains temperature
Flip-top lid prevents leaks
Stainless steel for durability
Retains heat or chill
Odour-free for food safety
